title: ingest_dataset inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the Publish Data ingest tool (advertised name honua_ingest_dataset). Loads a small inline dataset (CSV with a header row, or a GeoJSON FeatureCollection; 4 MB cap) into the reference implementation's catalog database as a table, returning the {connectionId, schema, table} triple plus row count and per-row errors so the result chains directly into publish_service. CSV point geometry comes from longitude/latitude columns (auto-detected or explicit), a WKT column, or a server-geocoded address column; coordinate order is lon/lat and the CRS defaults to EPSG:4326. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

format.description: Inline data format: "csv" (text with a header row) or "geojson" (a GeoJSON FeatureCollection document).

data.description: The dataset content, inline. Capped at 4 MB; larger datasets use the implementation's out-of-band upload surface.

datasetName.description: Target dataset/table name (letters, digits, underscores; must not start with a digit).

sourceSrid.description: Spatial reference (SRID/WKID) of the input coordinates; data is stored in EPSG:4326. Defaults to 4326 (WGS84 lon/lat).

longitudeColumn.description: CSV only: explicit longitude (X) column name. Pair with latitudeColumn. When omitted, lon/lng/long/longitude/x is auto-detected.

latitudeColumn.description: CSV only: explicit latitude (Y) column name. Pair with longitudeColumn. When omitted, lat/latitude/y is auto-detected.

addressColumn.description: CSV only: column holding freeform addresses to geocode into point geometry server-side (up to 100 rows). Mutually exclusive with longitudeColumn/latitudeColumn.
